currency: GBP (£), as specified in UCI dataset metadata.
revenue_scope: Gross eligible positive-price merchandise value; excludes service charges and adjustments and is not net of returns.

formulas.gross_positive_sales_value: sum(Quantity * Price) for numeric-invoice, non-C, positive-quantity, positive-price Merchandise lines, after exact-row deduplication; service charges are separate
formulas.signed_cancellation_return_value: sum(Quantity * Price) for C-prefixed, negative-quantity, positive-price Merchandise lines, after exact-row deduplication; negative signed amount
formulas.net_sales_after_defined_returns: gross merchandise sales + signed merchandise cancellation/return value; excludes service charges, adjustments, vouchers, zero-price lines, and unpriced quantity signals
formulas.service_charge_revenue_separate: positive value of eligible numeric-invoice non-C postage/carriage/shipping lines; shown separately from merchandise revenue
formulas.net_transaction_value_including_defined_: net merchandise sales + service charges + signed service cancellation value
formulas.orders: distinct invoices with at least one eligible ordinary-sale line
formulas.customers: distinct non-missing Customer IDs on eligible ordinary-sale invoices
formulas.units: sum Quantity > 0 only where invoice is non-C-prefixed and UnitPrice > 0, after exact-row deduplication; zero-price quantities are reported separately
formulas.average_order_value: gross positive-sale value / distinct eligible ordinary-sale invoices
formulas.revenue_per_identified_customer: identified-customer eligible sales value / distinct identified eligible-sale customers
formulas.c_invoice_return_line_rate: eligible C-prefixed negative-quantity return lines / eligible ordinary-sale lines
formulas.repeat_customer_rate: identified customers with more than one distinct eligible order / identified eligible-sale customers
formulas.revenue_growth: (Jan-Nov 2011 eligible gross sales / Jan-Nov 2010 eligible gross sales) - 1; both are complete 11-month calendar windows
formulas.customer_revenue_concentration: eligible identified-customer revenue for top 10 customers / all eligible identified-customer revenue
